note: Frozen thresholds transcribed from the M013a protocol. M013b adds no favorable post-test criterion. Where M013a named a gate but declared no numeric threshold, the value stays null and the gate can never return pass.

support.denominator_rule: Support is counted in independent leakage-group units within the eligible population for the exact metric. Total slice groups must never substitute for the answerable-group population of an accuracy metric.

primary.choice: paired answerable final-choice accuracy, abstentions counted as errors, paired by independent leakage group
primary.binary: Brier improvement over the train-prior constant baseline, reported per ID and OOD family
primary.favorable: primary 95% paired bootstrap interval lies wholly above zero
primary.unfavorable: primary 95% paired bootstrap interval lies wholly below zero

choice_gates.rationale: The frozen M013a protocol requires positive to satisfy the primary CI together with support, counterfactual and critical OOD gates, but declares no numeric counterfactual, critical OOD, answerability or calibration success threshold. These criteria therefore cannot be established retrospectively against the observed M013a test rows.

binary_gates.critical_regression_rule: a critical family whose Brier improvement 95% interval lies wholly below zero is a supported critical regression and yields negative

negative_controls.rule: A control must never satisfy the learned-improvement criterion. always_abstain has zero answerable accuracy and a perfect no-answer recall, so its recall must never be read as evidence of learned answerability.
